newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Jan-Sept unmilled rice output seen up.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Jan-Sept unmilled rice output seen up.

text.p: The Philippines' unmilled rice production is expected to reach 7.14 million tonnes, or 1.05 percent higher for the first nine months of the year compared to 7.07 million tonnes in the same period last year, the Bureau of Agricultural Statistics said on Friday.

The state-run agency said the higher rice production for the first nine months of the year may be brought about by a 1.72 percent growth in yield at 2.95 tonnes per hectare from 2.90 tonnes in the same period last year.
The output for the first six months, however, was expected to be lower at 4.88 million tonnes from last year's 4.95 million due to a drop in the total rice harvest area.
